title: Sky and textures
author: claude
summary: We gathered a garden sky and surface textures, took the sun out of the sky, and colour-matched everything.
what: We downloaded free textures and a garden sky picture, removed the sun from the sky, and colour-corrected the room's surfaces.
why: The room needs a view outdoors and surfaces that look real. The sun is removed from the sky picture so Blender can add its own sun at exactly the right angle and strength.
how:
- Download the free textures and the sky.
- Prepare the garden sky without its sun, in several sizes.
- Colour-correct the oak, paint, walnut, linen, marble and other textures, and generate the rug, the rug fuzz and the fig leaf pictures.

tech.name: Poly Haven
tech.plain: A free library of textures and sky pictures that anyone may use.

tech.name: HDRI sky picture
tech.plain: A photo that records a huge range of brightness, used as a realistic sky and light source.

tech.name: Python scripts
tech.plain: Small programs that tell Blender what to build and bake, so every step can be repeated.

meta.note: Written afterwards; the time only orders the timeline.
